run_GPUTrainingCoordinator: run GPU-accelerated graph embedding training with multi-GPU scheduling and sub-bucket edge partitioning
build_bipartite_schedule: build a bipartite GPU scheduling plan that pairs sub-partitions across left and right entity partitions
build_nonbipartite_schedule: build a non-bipartite GPU scheduling plan that recursively pairs sub-partitions for same-type entity training
create_GPUProcess: create a GPU subprocess that copies embeddings to device, processes edge batches, and syncs gradients back
review_GPUProcessPool: review the GPU process pool that manages multiple GPU worker processes and schedules training jobs
